newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. Defence Secretary Cohen ends Gulf trip, reiterates full support to his country's allies.
- Gulf states worried over weevil threat to date palms.
- Cargo, hull insurance rates drop in the Gulf.
- UAE affirms support for Palestinians during visit to Abu Dhabi by Palestinian President Arafat.
- Korean paint manufacturer Boo Sung Yang Heyang to set up a plant in Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone.
- Dubai expects value of industrial investments to reach 11 billion dirhams by the year 2001.
- GEC-Marconi in remote sensing joint venture in the UAE as part of its offset commitments.
